subject.title: fix(security): add default pidsLimit for sandbox containers

question: Should OpenClaw make a positive Docker sandbox `pidsLimit` the default for existing unset configs, and what opt-out, docs, tests, and proof are required before that ships?
rationale: The mitigation addresses a real sandbox hardening gap, but it changes an effective runtime default for existing deployments and can affect availability, so automation should not choose the security-versus-compatibility policy.

options.title: Approve default with upgrade proof
options.body: Keep the default-on PID cap only after schema/type/docs/tests and real Docker proof show fresh-install, upgrade, and explicit override behavior.

options.title: Keep default unset
options.body: Preserve current upgrade behavior and document operator-configured `pidsLimit` instead of changing all unset deployments.

options.title: Make the cap opt-in
options.body: Introduce a maintainer-approved strict profile or setting if maintainers want the mitigation without changing existing unset configs.

recommendation.title: Approve default with upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Keep the default-on PID cap only after schema/type/docs/tests and real Docker proof show fresh-install, upgrade, and explicit override behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS assigns the affected sandbox security runtime and docs surfaces to this team.
